title: Supervision second pass: wire detection plane + loop detector + timeout classification + alert evidence
summary: Five linear slices across the four analysis areas from issue #3665: (1) populate all 13 EventStreamSnapshot fields in snapshot_from_health_context(); (2) wire _run_overseer_detection_plane() into RUNTIME_TICK with double-evaluation guard + route findings to alert surface; (3) implement a deterministic unique-tool-input loop detector reading midturn_messages from the snapshot; (4) classify timeout-killed pods (exit -1 from asyncio.timeout) as clean timeouts not crashes, surface the 2h timeout to agents via heartbeat, and make the timeout configurable per-pipeline; (5) enrich OVERSEER_ALERT payloads with evidence and fix the convergence-stall false positive by unifying timestamp sources. Slices are linear because they share overlapping files (kubernetes_monitor.py, detection_plane.py, health_monitor.py).

scope_notes.linear_chain: Slices are a linear chain (1->2->3->4->5) because they share overlapping files. The #3046 overlap validator requires overlapping slices to be ordered along one dependency chain.
scope_notes.tier_1_2_only: Per the gate's scope discipline: Tier 1 and Tier 2 items from the 30-item candidate list are implemented; Tier 3-5 are input to the gate only.
scope_notes.soft_dependency: slice-5 TASK-5-3 (timeout naming in alerts) depends on slice-4 TASK-4-3 (timeout classification).

grounding.detection_plane: snapshot_from_health_context() at health_checks/detection_plane.py:511 populates only 5 of 13 EventStreamSnapshot fields. RunningAgent(role=str(cid)) at line 536 uses container ID as role. _run_overseer_detection_plane() at routes/pipelines/_overseer.py:309 has zero call sites. run_detection_plane() at health_checks/runner.py:159 exists but is never invoked.
grounding.runtime_tick: _run_runtime_tick_checks() at kubernetes_monitor.py:221 is called from _check_pod (line 218) and _reconciliation_sweep (line 616). Must guard against double-evaluation.
grounding.timeout: sandbox/llm/claude/config.py:23 — ClaudeConfig.timeout=7200. shared/egg_agent/client.py:765 — asyncio.timeout(timeout). client.py:903-921 — TimeoutError handler returns returncode=-1. kubernetes_monitor.py:1148 — _classify_exit() treats -1 as FAILED. event_loop/_supervisor.py:145 — record_abort() increments _streaks.
grounding.loop_detection: health_checks/detection_plane.py:126 — midturn_messages field (never populated). client.py:819-830 — tool calls logged via logger.info. kubernetes_client.py:455 — read_job_log_snapshot with tail_lines=2000, ~100 char truncation. agent_log_store.py:51 — MAX_LOG_BYTES=1MB.
grounding.alerting: overseer/monitor/_alerting.py:56 — _broadcast_alert() sends minimal payload. event_loop/_loop.py:859 — _check_convergence_stall uses tracker.get_latest_progress_timestamp(). health_monitor.py:388 — _has_recent_peer_progress uses same tracker but different gate window.

tasks.description: Populate runtime section of EventStreamSnapshot. Wire driver_heartbeat.tick_age_seconds() and spawn_age_seconds() into snapshot_from_health_context() under raw["runtime"]. This activates detect_run_pipeline_thread_liveness() and DriverLivenessCheck.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: snapshot.raw.runtime contains tick_age_s and spawn_age_s; detect_run_pipeline_thread_liveness fires when the driver thread is stale.

tasks.description: Populate consensus section of snapshot. Wire peer_consensus.get_peer_consensus_tracker().evaluate() into the snapshot builder. This activates detect_brc_thrash(), detect_incomplete_consensus_deferral(), and consensus field readers in PhaseStallDetector.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: snapshot.consensus contains tracker.evaluate() output; detectors reading consensus field fire correctly.

tasks.description: Populate container_transitions from kubernetes_monitor pod-state log. Wire KubernetesMonitor._pod_states into the snapshot. This activates detect_container_death(), detect_container_oom_evicted(), detect_container_restart_loop(), detect_overseer_self_injection().
tasks.acceptance_criteria: snapshot.container_transitions contains pod state transitions; container death/oom/restart detectors fire on real transitions.

tasks.description: Fix RunningAgent role field and populate age fields. Use agent role from pipeline state instead of container ID; populate last_tool_call_age_s and last_heartbeat_age_s from health monitor anchors. This activates detect_heartbeat_stall().
tasks.acceptance_criteria: RunningAgent.role is the agent role (not container ID); last_tool_call_age_s and last_heartbeat_age_s are populated; detect_heartbeat_stall fires on stale heartbeats.

tasks.description: Populate midturn_messages in snapshot. Wire agent tool-call logs into snapshot_from_health_context() as midturn_messages tuples. This is the prerequisite for the loop detector in slice-3.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: snapshot.midturn_messages contains tool-call records with tool_name and input_hash; populated from agent_log_store or live pod logs.

tasks.description: Tests for snapshot population. Verify all 13 EventStreamSnapshot fields are populated.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests assert all 13 fields populated; runtime, consensus, container_transitions, midturn_messages all non-empty.

phases.name: Wire the detection plane into RUNTIME_TICK

tasks.description: Wire _run_overseer_detection_plane() into RUNTIME_TICK path. Call it from _run_runtime_tick_checks() after building the snapshot, routing requires_adjudication findings to the overseer agent and routine findings to the corrective executor. Guard against double-evaluation (two call sites: _check_pod and _reconciliation_sweep).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Detection plane runs on every RUNTIME_TICK sweep; findings with requires_adjudication escalate to overseer; routine findings emit to event bus; no double-evaluation on dual call sites.

tasks.description: Route detection-plane findings to the operator alert surface. Route findings to the same OVERSEER_ALERT / HITL / Slack surfaces the overseer uses, so the operator sees one consistent alert stream.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Detection-plane findings appear on the OVERSEER_ALERT surface; requires_adjudication findings escalate to overseer; routine findings emit to event bus.

tasks.description: Tests for detection plane wiring. Verify the detection plane is called from RUNTIME_TICK; verify no double-evaluation; verify findings are routed to the alert surface.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests assert detection plane invoked on RUNTIME_TICK; double-evaluation guard prevents duplicate findings; findings routed to alert surface.

tasks.description: Implement detect_tool_input_loop() in health_checks/tier1/. Read midturn_messages from the snapshot, count distinct tool-input strings over a trailing window (e.g. 5 polls). If the count is zero for N consecutive polls, fire tool_input_loop / high with requires_adjudication=False. Must handle variable cycle shapes (1-, 2-, 3-, 8-cycles) — not keyed on a fixed shape.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Detector fires on zero-new-input windows of any cycle shape; does not fire on productive agents; evidence includes the tool input hash and window size.

tasks.description: Increase log capture fidelity for one-shot event pods. The k8s log API truncates at ~100 chars per line (kubernetes_client.py:455 read_job_log_snapshot with tail_lines=2000). Increase fidelity so the unique-tool-input counter has enough data to distinguish distinct tool calls sharing a prefix.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tool call log lines are captured at full length (not truncated to 100 chars); the loop detector can distinguish distinct tool calls sharing a prefix.

tasks.description: Tests for the loop detector. Verify it fires on zero-new-input windows, does not fire on productive agents, handles variable cycle shapes (1-, 2-, 3-, 8-cycles).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests cover single-input, 2-cycle, 3-cycle, and 8-cycle loops; productive agent with new tool inputs does not trigger; evidence payload is correct.

tasks.description: Add agent_timeout_seconds to PipelineConfig (default 7200).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: PipelineConfig.agent_timeout_seconds field exists with default 7200; validated >= 60.

tasks.description: Pass EGG_AGENT_TIMEOUT env through the spawner so the agent can self-report its remaining budget.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Spawner sets EGG_AGENT_TIMEOUT env var from PipelineConfig.agent_timeout_seconds; agent reads it and can self-report remaining budget.

tasks.description: Classify timeout-killed pods distinctly. When exit_code == -1 and the timeout fired (detectable via agent result error message 'Timed out after {timeout} seconds'), classify as a clean timeout, not a crash. Add JOB_OUTCOME_TIMEOUT outcome and route to record_timeout (not record_abort).
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Timeout-killed pods classified as clean timeout; failure streak NOT incremented; alert says 'killed by 2h agent timeout'.

tasks.description: Surface the timeout to the agent via heartbeat. Emit a HEARTBEAT with state WAITING_FOR_EVENT and body 'approaching 2h timeout' at 90-minute intervals.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Agent receives a heartbeat warning at 90 minutes; message is readable and actionable.

tasks.description: Tests for timeout classification. Verify timeout-killed pods don't increment the failure streak; verify the agent receives the warning heartbeat.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests assert streak untouched by timeout; heartbeat warning emitted at 90 minutes; exit classification distinguishes timeout from crash.

tasks.description: Enrich OVERSEER_ALERT payloads with evidence. Add structured evidence (container logs, BRC state, tracker evaluation) to _broadcast_alert().
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Alert payloads include evidence dict with container logs, BRC state, and tracker evaluation; operator can diagnose without grepping.

tasks.description: Fix the convergence-stall false positive. Unify the timestamp source between _check_convergence_stall() (event_loop/_loop.py:859) and _has_recent_peer_progress() (health_monitor.py:388). Both should use the same 'bus activity' signal.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Convergence-stall alert does not fire when peer heartbeat is seconds old and health monitor logs the agent as alive; same timestamp source used for both alerting and deferral.

tasks.description: Name the 2-hour timeout explicitly in exit classification. When a pod is killed by timeout, the alert should say 'killed by 2h agent timeout' not 'container exited with code -1.' (Depends on TASK-4-3.)
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Exit classification message for timeout-killed pods says 'killed by 2h agent timeout'; distinct from crash classification.

tasks.description: Tests for alert evidence and false-positive fixes. Verify alerts carry evidence; verify convergence-stall doesn't fire when peer heartbeat is recent.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Tests assert evidence in alert payloads; convergence-stall does not fire when peer heartbeat is recent; timeout classification message is correct.

non_goals: Rebuilding the overseer agent (working; problem is input pipeline).
Removing the HealthMonitor tripwires (wired and working).
Adding LLM classification to the hot path (expensive Haiku calls).
Changing the 2-hour timeout default (7200s is reasonable).
Tier 3-5 from the candidate list (input to the gate, not a work queue).
risks_for_reviewers: slice-1 TASK-1-5 adds midturn_messages population — depends on parsing agent logs which are truncated at ~100 chars in the k8s log API. slice-3 TASK-3-2 addresses this by increasing log fidelity.

slice-2 TASK-2-1 adds a new code path on the hot loop (_run_runtime_tick_checks). Must be exception-isolated and guarded against double-evaluation (two call sites: _check_pod and _reconciliation_sweep).
slice-2 TASK-2-1 (consensus section) depends on get_peer_consensus_tracker() which may return None — must handle gracefully.

slice-4 TASK-4-3 (timeout classification) must distinguish timeout-killed pods (exit -1 from asyncio.timeout) from real crashes (also exit -1) via the agent result's error message ('Timed out after {timeout} seconds').
slice-4 TASK-4-3 adds JOB_OUTCOME_TIMEOUT — must verify it doesn't interfere with the existing EX_AUTH_FATAL / EX_RATE_LIMITED exit code chain (#3364 PR C).
slice-5 TASK-5-2 (timestamp unification) must not regress the #2242 progress gate behavior — the same tracker.get_latest_progress_timestamp() is used by both, but with different gate windows.
slice-5 TASK-5-3 depends on slice-4 TASK-4-3 (timeout classification) for the 'killed by 2h agent timeout' message.

ordering.cross_slice: Linear chain: slice-1 -> slice-2 -> slice-3 -> slice-4 -> slice-5. Slices share overlapping files (kubernetes_monitor.py, detection_plane.py, health_monitor.py) so they cannot be independent parallel slices per #3046.
ordering.intra_slice_1: TASK-1-1 (runtime) -> TASK-1-2 (consensus) -> TASK-1-3 (container_transitions) -> TASK-1-4 (running_agents) -> TASK-1-5 (midturn_messages) -> TASK-1-6 (tests). All populate snapshot fields; order is by increasing complexity.
ordering.intra_slice_2: TASK-2-1 (wire detection plane) -> TASK-2-2 (route to alert surface) -> TASK-2-3 (tests). Step 1 is prerequisite for step 2.
ordering.intra_slice_3: TASK-3-1 (loop detector) -> TASK-3-2 (log fidelity) -> TASK-3-3 (tests). Step 2 improves data quality for step 1; step 3 tests both.
ordering.intra_slice_4: TASK-4-1 (config) -> TASK-4-2 (env passthrough) -> TASK-4-3 (classification) -> TASK-4-4 (heartbeat warning) -> TASK-4-5 (tests). Steps 1-2 are prerequisites for step 3; step 4 is independent.
ordering.intra_slice_5: TASK-5-1 (evidence) -> TASK-5-2 (timestamp fix) -> TASK-5-3 (timeout naming, depends on TASK-4-3) -> TASK-5-4 (tests).
